#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <UIKit/UIKit.h>
#include <sys/utsname.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

// Validate before serialization: unsupported values (including NaN in legacy
// preferences) can raise an exception even when an NSError parameter is supplied.
// Keep these bridges compatible with Objective-C exceptions disabled by Unity.
static char *CopyJson(NSDictionary *value)
{
    if (value == nil || ![NSJSONSerialization isValidJSONObject:value]) return NULL;
    NSError *error = nil;
    NSData *json = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:value options:0 error:&error];
    if (json == nil || error != nil) return NULL;
    char *result = (char *)malloc(json.length + 1);
    if (result == NULL) return NULL;
    memcpy(result, json.bytes, json.length);
    result[json.length] = '\0';
    return result;
}

extern "C" char *RTE_ReadDeviceProperties()
{
    @autoreleasepool
    {
        UIDevice *device = [UIDevice currentDevice];
        if (device == nil) return NULL;
        struct utsname hardware;
        NSString *model = uname(&hardware) == 0 ? [NSString stringWithUTF8String:hardware.machine] : nil;
        if (model == nil) model = device.model;
        NSString *language = [[[NSLocale preferredLanguages] firstObject] lowercaseString];
        NSString *version = device.systemVersion;
        // Dictionary literals and stringByAppendingString: reject nil arguments.
        NSDictionary *properties = @{
            @"device.category": device.userInterfaceIdiom == UIUserInterfaceIdiomPad ? @"tablet" : @"mobile",
            @"device.user_default_language": [language stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:@"_" withString:@"-"] ?: (id)[NSNull null],
            @"device.mobile_brand_name": @"Apple",
            @"device.mobile_marketing_name": model ?: (id)[NSNull null],
            @"device.mobile_model_name": model ?: (id)[NSNull null],
            @"device.mobile_os_hardware_model": model ?: (id)[NSNull null],
            @"device.operating_system": @"iOS",
            @"device.operating_system_version": version != nil ? (id)[@"iOS " stringByAppendingString:version] : (id)[NSNull null],
            @"device.time_zone_offset_seconds": @([[NSTimeZone localTimeZone] secondsFromGMTForDate:[NSDate date]])
        };
        return CopyJson(properties);
    }
}

extern "C" void RTE_FreeDeviceProperties(char *value)
{
    free(value);
}

// SDK 3.0.3 uses standard UserDefaults, not Unity's PlayerPrefs key/type mapping.
extern "C" char *RTE_ReadLegacyState()
{
    @autoreleasepool
    {
        NSUserDefaults *defaults = [NSUserDefaults standardUserDefaults];
        if (defaults == nil) return NULL;
        NSMutableDictionary *state = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
        for (NSString *key in @[@"user_pseudo_id", @"session_number", @"first_seen_ms", @"rt2_anchor_ms"])
        {
            id value = [defaults objectForKey:[@"com.databuckets." stringByAppendingString:key]];
            if ([value isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] || [value isKindOfClass:[NSNumber class]])
                state[key] = value;
        }
        return CopyJson(state);
    }
}
